study: Does hedging the live overnight book with an equal-weight index (RSP) instead of SPY keep a significant edge with little market exposure?
registered_at: 2026-10-06 ~19:30 ET, before any RSP data is fetched or any RSP-hedged return is computed
origin: Operator 10/6 'can we improve the overnight book?'. 2000-2015 (OVERNIGHT_PRE2016_2026-10-04.md): the RANKING edge (picks minus the equal-weighted liquid universe) is +8.6 bp/night, t 9.7, 15/16 years, while alpha vs SPY after costs is unproven. Hypothesis: an equal-weight hedge tracks the book's universe better than SPY and keeps more of the ranking edge.
frozen_book: the live rule, unchanged: top-20 12-1 momentum, raw close >= $5, ADV20 >= $50M, close -> next open, equal weight, 4 bp round trip (as in overnight_hedge_intraday.py and overnight_pre2016.py)

hedge.instrument: RSP (Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF), short overnight close -> next open with the same auction legs
hedge.ratio_primary: h = trailing 252-night OLS beta of the book's net overnight return on RSP's overnight return, using nights t-252..t-1 only (point-in-time; min 200 nights)
hedge.cost: 3 bp per unit of hedge per round trip (RSP is less liquid than SPY's 2.26 bp); 6 bp as a sensitivity

comparison_baseline: the same book hedged with SPY at its own trailing 252-night beta, 2.26 bp per unit

data.period_A: 2004-05-03 .. 2015-12-30 (first night with >= 200 prior book nights) (RSP listed 2003-04-30; one year of beta warm-up): the book from the 2000-2015 Yahoo pipeline (tools/studies/overnight_pre2016.py, its registered masks and dividend-inclusive ON); RSP and SPY from Yahoo daily (auto_adjust=False, actions=True, ON = (Open(t+1) + Div(t+1)) / Close(t) - 1)
data.period_B: from the first night with >= 200 prior book nights (~2017-10; the panel starts 2016-01-04 and book nights at ~2017-01-13) .. 2026-09-24, about 2,240 nights; the book from the Alpaca panel (as overnight_hedge_intraday.py); RSP from Alpaca SIP daily bars with adjustment=all; SPY as in the panel
data.data_source_check: RSP AND SPY overnight returns, Yahoo vs Alpaca, 2017-2021: correlation >= 0.99 and |mean nightly difference| <= 0.5 bp each; if either fails, period A gets no verdict and the overall verdict is UNPROVEN
data.bad_data: a night is dropped (counted) if RSP's open or prior close is missing or |RSP ON| > 15%; the share of RSP nights with ON exactly 0 is reported by year and any year above 25% is dropped from both hedges; one common night set is used for the RSP and SPY hedges

statistic: RSP-hedged net per night = book net - h x RSP_ON - 3 bp x |h|; mean bp/night, SE = max(plain, Newey-West 5, Newey-West 9). Paired RSP-minus-SPY hedged difference is reported with its t (information; tracking decides, not the paired mean, which is a cap- vs equal-weight bet)
power: period A: MDE = 2.84 x SE <= 5 bp required; period B: reported only (underpowered by construction)
pass: Period A decides: RSP-hedged net > 0 with t >= 2, still > 0 at 6 bp hedge cost, AND tracking is better than the SPY hedge (lower SD of the hedged series AND higher R^2 of the book on RSP than on SPY, on the common night set). Period B must have RSP-hedged net > 0 (B is underpowered by construction: SE ~2.4-2.5 bp, MDE ~7 bp); if B is <= 0 the verdict is UNPROVEN. SURVIVORSHIP RULE for period A: report the decomposition RSP-hedged = S2 + (universe alpha vs RSP) - 4 bp - 3 bp x h; if A passes only because universe alpha vs RSP > 0 (i.e. S2 - 4 - 3h <= 0), the verdict is UNPROVEN. Power for A: MDE = 2.84 x SE must be <= 5 bp, else UNPROVEN. A FAIL closes the hedge-instrument question (no IWM/MDY/other follow-ups). A pass is input to gate O1 only.
information_only: realised beta of the RSP-hedged book to SPY
worst night, CVaR 1%, max drawdown, Sharpe for unhedged / SPY-hedged / RSP-hedged
realised beta of the RSP-hedged book to RSP by year, the path of h, and the fixed-h gap
10 bp hedge cost (2004-08 RSP was thin)
no_retuning: instrument, beta window, costs, periods and the pass bar are fixed here; a FAIL closes the hedge-instrument question
prior: LOW: expected RSP-hedged ~ 8.6 (S2) - 4 - ~3.6 (3 bp x h) ~ +1 bp plus universe alpha vs RSP; the SPY trailing hedge gave +0.76 (2000-15) and +1.71 (t 0.6, 2018-26)
caveats: shorting RSP at the auctions is assumed available at the stated cost; live borrow is not modelled
RSP has its own rebalancing and fees, included in its returns
survivorship: period A's universe is names that existed in 2016-2026; RSP includes delisted names, so the hedge passes the bias through (handled by the decomposition rule)

LIVE FEASIBILITY: Alpaca blocks shorting below $2,000 equity and has no fractional shorts; RSP ~ $185/share. NOT actionable for the $100 live account; only relevant at several thousand dollars. Borrow and opg/cls short orders on RSP to be verified read-only before any use.
